result.topic_en: Lecture-style notes on finding a function of a complex variable whose modulus is constant along each of given circles (a conformal-mapping problem for circular boundaries), ending with a symmetry (reflection) principle relating u+vi and -u+vi to x+yi and -x+yi across the line x=0.

items.english: To determine a function of a complex variable, for all values represented by points of a region bounded by given circles, such that its modulus takes a constant value along each of these circles.
We have now seen that a function of a complex variable can be determined in this way once and only in one way.

items.english: To find the dependence of the quantity z on Z, i.e. to express z in terms of Z or Z in terms of z.
